DHCPv4::siaddr
       This command returns siaddr(server IP) field from DHCPv4 message.

SYNOPSIS
       DHCPv4::siaddr

DESCRIPTION
       This command returns siaddr(server IP) field from DHCPv4 message

       Details (syntax): DHCPv4::siaddr

RETURN VALUE
       This command returns siaddr(server IP) field from DHCPv4 message

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_DATA {
	    log local0. "Siaddr [DHCPv4::siaddr]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0
	    --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
